newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal makes 2.75 pct public sector wage offer.
newsitem.headline: Portugal makes 2.75 pct public sector wage offer.

text.p: The Portuguese government was preparing to offer public sector unions wage increases of 2.75 percent for 1997 in talks on Monday, a spokesman said.
"The proposal of the government is 2.75 percent," the spokesman for Assistant Minister to the Prime Minister Jorge Coelho said.
Coelho will head the government team at the talks with unions representing the country's some 500,000 public sector employees.
The government's previous offer of 2.6 percent was spurned by unions, which are pressing for increases in excess of 3.5 percent.

The government has warned that it cannot afford to pay much more than its 2.5-percent forecast inflation rate for next year without jeopardising Portugal's chances of qualifying for Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).
